newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Ecopetrol opens new bidding process.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Ecopetrol opens new bidding process.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol said it was seeking bids from foreign oil companies interested in exploring and developing the "Retorno I" oil and gas field in northern Santander province.

The field, where oil has been discovered beneath a shallower field known as Provincia at depths greater than 12,000 feet (3,650 meters), is believed to have reserves of anywhere between 74 million and 300 million barrels of oil, Ecopetrol said in a statement.
It intends to exploit the field under terms of a so- called "shared risk" contract, whereby Ecopetrol would cover 50 percent of all exploration costs.
The winning bidder, according to the statement, would be the company that offers Ecopetrol the greatest share of profits from the field, in excess of a guaranteed minimum of 50 percent.
